title: My Son-In-Law Made Me Co-Sign $200K, Vanished. So I Made Him Change Oil As Dipstick Of Deceit
description: After my son-in-law tricked me into co-signing a $200K loan and vanished, the bank foreclosed on my home. I tracked him through a luxury car he bought with embezzled funds, won a judgment, and now he works at my auto shop wearing a jumpsuit labeled Dipstick of Deceit. #RevengeStory #Karma #FamilyBetrayal
thumb_text: HE TOOK MY HOUSE, NOW HE'S THE DIPSTICK OF DECEIT
pinned_comment: If my son-in-law had tricked you into co-signing a $200K loan and vanished, leaving you homeless, would you have made him work it off in a jumpsuit that says Dipstick of Deceit? Share your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: I WON A JUDGMENT AND NOW HE CHANGES OIL AT MY SHOP
